cases.name: default-fold
cases.covers: Case and marks both folded, which is the persistable corpus fold.

cases.name: keep-marks
cases.covers: matchDiacritics: case folded, marks kept and left decomposed.

cases.name: keep-both
cases.covers: Both flags on: only whitespace collapse and NFKD remain.

cases.name: whitespace-collapse
cases.covers: A line-wrapped run collapses to one space, and the map still points at the first one.

cases.name: decomposition-emits-whitespace
cases.covers: U+00A8 decomposes to space plus combining diaeresis, so the collapse runs at unit level.

cases.name: ligature-expands
cases.covers: NFKD splits a ligature into two units that both map back to one code point.

cases.name: superscript-expands
cases.covers: A compatibility decomposition that changes the character class.

cases.name: sharp-s-expands
cases.covers: The upper-lower round trip catches ss, which toLowerCase alone misses.

cases.name: final-sigma-normalizes
cases.covers: And the Greek case it also catches.

cases.name: astral-maps-back-to-two-units
cases.covers: The map is in UTF-16 code units, so a supplementary code point occupies one entry per folded unit and points at its first unit.

cases.name: leading-and-trailing-whitespace
cases.covers: Collapse at the edges, which the needle trim depends on.

cases.name: kelvin-and-long-s
cases.covers: The characters the regex case-folding cases use, through the other path.
